value.rationale: A local spectral multiplier does not control macroscopic phase capture. This theorem quantifies the natural transient from any fixed phase in an entire return bin on the exact exponentially long timescale, proves loss of initial-distance and rotation-numerator memory, and provides a sharp family of hitting-time constants for prescribed inverse-steepness tolerance. These are nontrivial and physically meaningful dynamical distinctions.
